item.description:
ShabuBox 2.6.1

A small update about the anonymous usage statistics ShabuBox can send — what they include, when they're sent, and how accurately they count — plus one fix to the library's safety check. Your documents, file names and anything you type are still never sent.

Usage statistics

  • Settings says exactly what's shared — the description under Settings → General → Privacy now also covers how well on-device features worked: whether an answer found a source, a rough response-time range, and whether a filing suggestion was taken. Nothing in it can carry your documents, file names, folders, search text or questions.
  • An idle Mac isn't counted as in use — work ShabuBox does on its own while nobody is at the Mac (filing documents iCloud delivered overnight, the scanner watcher switching itself off, a library check) no longer starts a usage session. It is reported the next time you use the app instead.
  • Counted once, not twice — importing files that were still in iCloud counted the import twice, and returning to a search counted it again. Each is now counted once.
  • The switch is honest — in a copy of ShabuBox that can't send statistics, the Share anonymous usage statistics switch is greyed out instead of looking like it does something.

Fixed

  • Confirm Files Were Deleted stays available — when ShabuBox stops itself from removing many documents at once because they seem to have disappeared, the Confirm Files Were Deleted option in the Files menu no longer vanishes after a library check that hit an error part-way.

Notes

  • No re-read, no library changes and nothing to do — this update installs and opens like any other.
  • You can turn usage statistics off at any time in Settings → General → Privacy; turning them off stops collection immediately and discards anything not yet sent.
